record: Men's work, women's work and the wash, in a browser (sim/custom.mjs, sim/housework.mjs)
note: Same computer only, headless Chrome at 1366x768. One real class through the join flow on the invented country (seed custom-proof-38). No LAN or district claim.
checks: flies are drawn over Samuel Proofwright at home, his clothes unwashed for a week ({"x":717,"y":568,"sprite":false})

with Samuel Proofwright at home, none of the men's work is on Almira Proofwright's bar (plant-field, visit-shop, buy-furniture, milk-cow, keep-house, work-garden, wash-clothes, travel-gonzales, visit, work, rest); an order for it anyway is refused: "Building is men's work, and Samuel is at home."
the cue: Almira Proofwright idle and the house not kept today - the pot pulsing on her portrait (20x20, cue-pulse) and Keep house glowing (cue-glow); on nobody else, no words
sent to the garden, the cue leaves Almira Proofwright's portrait

help, not lead: with Samuel Proofwright at the house it is on Almira Proofwright's bar with the helping-hands badge ("Helps Samuel, and leaves off when they do."); pressed, she joins him: "Almira Proofwright went to help Samuel: work on the house."

the errand popup says "Samuel's clothes want washing: the shops ask a quarter more and pay a fifth less.", and 31 prices are dearer, seed "2 reales or 3.75 food for 2 seed (1 real or 3 food to a clean customer)"
with Samuel Proofwright on the road to town, build-house appears on Almira Proofwright's bar, lit
the family's story says: "With Samuel gone to town and no son old enough, Almira went to work on the house herself."

in gonzales: "Ruth Crandall at Gonzales wrinkled her nose at Samuel Proofwright's clothes: "Stand a little off from the counter, if you please.""; drawn over the speaker: "Stand a little off from the counter, if you please."; flies over him
with Samuel Proofwright on the errand and Almira Proofwright at home, Joseph Proofwright (11) has neither Keep house nor the wash on his bar

children keep house: with Samuel Proofwright gone to the store and Almira Proofwright to town, Joseph Proofwright (11) has keep-house and wash-clothes on his bar; drawn fire; the story: "Joseph Proofwright kept house: the cooking, the mending and the sweeping done, and the food made to go further." "Joseph Proofwright did the wash: the clothes of 4 boiled, beaten and hung on the fence to dry."
the story says: "Samuel Proofwright bought 2 seed at the store for 3.75 food - 3 food to a clean customer, but Marta Ibarra looked at Samuel Proofwright's clothes and asked more."
Almira Proofwright at work-garden: drawn hoe (mother-loose-work), and the garden drawn beside the house ({"x":683,"y":384,"half":23,"season":"growing"})
Almira Proofwright at wash-clothes: drawn scrub (mother-loose-work)

the story says: "Almira Proofwright laid out a kitchen garden beside the house. It will give a little every day it is worked, from tomorrow." "Almira Proofwright did a wash for Samuel and Almira, who wanted it before wash day: the clothes of 2 boiled, beaten and hung on the fence to dry."
the wash for whoever's dirty done, Samuel Proofwright's clothes are clean and no flies are drawn over him
hunt-timber left Almira Proofwright's bar with Samuel Proofwright home and came back when he went again, the same button
